soldier: Head orange-red, mandibles reddish brown and pale near the base, antennae orange-yellow, thoracic and abdominal tergites slightly paler than the head; head and pronotum with only a few long hairs. Head nearly oval, fontanelle at the centre of the head, eyes indistinct, in lateral view the dorsal margin slightly arched and the mentum projecting; labrum almost conical, the dorsum markedly arched, widest near the base, the apex of the transparent area narrowly rounded; mandibles slender and straight, the apex slightly curved, the base of the inner margin of the left mandible with an incision, with slight fine teeth below the midpoint, the inner margin of the right mandible smooth; postmentum nearly rectangular, the waist indistinct, narrowest at the anterior end, the sides somewhat parallel; antennae with 17 segments, segment 3 slightly longer than segment 2 or segment 4. Pronotum widest, the anterior and posterior margins both shallowly concave in the middle or the anterior concavity indistinct, the lateral lobes narrow and rounded; mesonotum narrowest, the posterior margin slightly concave in the middle, the lateral lobes nearly round; the posterior margin of the metanotum nearly straight, the lateral lobes nearly round.
